newsitem.title: INDIA: Japan's Yasuda Marine opens office in India.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Yasuda Marine opens office in India.

text.p: Japan's Yasuda Fire and Marine Insurance Co Ltd on Monday launched operations in India by opening a liaison office in the Indian capital.
Yasuda is the first Japanese insurance company to be granted permission to set up a liason office by the government of India.

India's insurance sector has been dominated by two state-owned companies, the Life Insurance Corp (LIC) and the General Insurance Corp (GIC), but Finance Minister P. Chidambaram last month announced the first steps towards opening up the sector.
He permitted only Indian firms to participate in health insurance and pension schemes through joint ventures with LIC and GIC. -- New Delhi newsroom +91-11 301 2024
